title: Adaptive priority funnel for isolated on-prem / VPC networking requests
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Problem: We receive a steady stream of customer requests to run Redwood Private in fully isolated or partially restricted networks (air-gapped, strict egress, appliance proxies). Current intake is manual, noisy, and often misprioritizes requests that are resource-heavy but low-business-impact. Goal: define an "adaptive priority funnel" that scores incoming private/VPC/on‑prem networking requests based on risk, readiness, and business value; map each score to a sequenced engagement lane (self-serve, assisted onboarding, engineering-led integration, fast-track), and standardize the preflight artifacts and comms required to move customers between lanes.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic scoring rubric exists (risk, business value, network readiness, legal/regulatory weight) and is documented in Confluence
Incoming requests are automatically annotated with initial readiness signals (customer-provided forms + automated probes) in the intake UI
Three engagement lanes defined with clear SLAs: self-serve (30d), concierge-assisted (14d), engineering integration (TBD per effort), plus an emergency fast-track for P0 enterprise customers
Each lane has required artifact checklist (network diagrams, egress matrix, maintenance windows, onprem contact) and a standardized email + Slack template
Pilot with 10 live customer requests runs for 4 weeks and achieves >60% correct lane assignment (manual overrides logged and analyzed)
Operational handoff: tickets created for ENG/OPS when safety gates are triggered (egress exceptions, KMS/HSM onprem), with documented owner and 72h SLA for initial response
implementation_notes: Leverage existing network probe scripts from PM-74102 and embed into intake form as optional automated step
Scoring factors (weights to be tuned) include: business value score, legal/regulatory score, network complexity score, upgrade risk score, prior security posture score
Prototype the funnel as a lightweight serverless evaluator that returns a lane and a short rationale string for UX display
Integration work: Frontend team to add lane suggestion in intake UI; Backend to store signals and computed score in ticket metadata
Plan a 4-week pilot with Solutions Eng and two existing pilot customers (one highly regulated, one SaaS with simple VPC)
